title: Membership in a unary language
statement: Let $S$ be a set of natural numbers and let $w$ be a Boolean word. Then $w$ belongs to the unary language determined by $S$ if and only if all bits of $w$ are true and the length of $w$ belongs to $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a set of natural numbers
